## Project Overview

This report details a time series forecasting project designed to predict daily cyclist volumes. The pipeline executes data preparation, model training, validation backtesting, and true out-of-sample forecasting for November 2025.

### Setup and Dependencies

The following libraries are required for data manipulation, weather API integration, modeling, and visualization[cite: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].
